## DottedKeys type

Builds dot-separated paths for nested object leaves.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DottedKeys<T, Depth = 0> = T extends object | null | undefined ? {
    [K in keyof T & string]: T[K] extends object | null | undefined ? `${K}.${Depth extends "MAX" ? any : DottedKeys<T[K], Inc<Depth>>}` : K;
}[keyof T & string] : "";
```
